value.title: ToolsEnabled on Machine B — Current State and Completion Report
value.summary: A point-in-time operational assessment of ToolsEnabled on Machine B covering the broker, JARVIS, fleet, dashboard, bridge, scheduler, audit, and owner-request surfaces. It distinguishes live observations from historical audit claims and identifies integration and truthful-operations risks.

value.title: Coordinator Audit — 2026-08-04
value.summary: An audit of post-council coordinator behavior and system artifacts that groups recurring failures into foundational design problems. It emphasizes mechanical authority, three-state observability, actuated monitoring, closure evidence, and enforcement at chokepoints.

value.title: ToolsEnabled — Full System Audit
value.summary: A full-system audit focused on architecture and onboarding, with a verified ranked findings set and candidate improvements. Its executive summary highlights repeated false-health patterns across live system surfaces.

value.title: ToolsEnabled — what went wrong, and what I think fixes it
value.summary: A coordinator-authored account of failures caused by per-tree state divergence and checks that confuse lack of visibility with failure. It proposes structural fixes for canonical-path identity and uncertainty-aware status reporting.

value.title: ToolsEnabled Stabilization Plan — independent audit
value.summary: An independent review of the cross-machine stabilization plan using multiple audit lenses. It concludes the diagnosis is largely sound but documents ordering, data-loss, verification, and executability defects that must be resolved before running the plan.

value.title: ToolsEnabled report-corpus audit and academic research roadmap
value.summary: A research audit of the ToolsEnabled report corpus and a roadmap for defensible studies. It identifies provenance, benchmark-validity, liveness, governance, and estimator-correction opportunities while stating the corpus limits.

value.title: HANDOFF — ToolsEnabled / Mission Control
value.summary: A transfer document mapping the canonical, retired, and Mission Control trees and recording the highest-priority runtime handoff. It documents that Mission Bridge execution requires an interactive logged-in session and includes the observed proof point for that fix.

value.title: Verify by re-running
value.guidance: Re-run a claim yourself before treating it as established.

value.title: Use the true merge-base
value.guidance: Diff against the true merge-base when evaluating a change.

value.title: Require a clean red probe
value.guidance: A red probe on a dirty tree is not evidence.

value.title: Separate geometry from judgment
value.guidance: Probes measure geometry; they do not substitute for judgment.

value.title: Preserve unavailable
value.guidance: Unavailable evidence must not be rendered or analyzed as zero.

value.title: Treat timeout as continuation
value.guidance: A timeout is a continuation state, not a successful result.

value.title: Generalize narrowly
value.guidance: Default to the narrowest claim supported by the observed incident.
